mission_rules: Present a novel capability gap rather than a repository name.
Change one material condition during the mission: disable a tool, contradict a source, or invalidate the first candidate.
AURA must independently discover candidate resources.
AURA must compare at least two candidates.
AURA must form a testable capability hypothesis before sandbox evaluation.
AURA must reject redundant capability rather than accumulating dependencies.
Repeat the mission once after failure or changed conditions and measure whether the second attempt improves.
note: The actual novel capability gap must be selected after this file is frozen; it must not be committed here in advance.
